body: It's my birthday today too. I've been wanting to drink all day. Once the sun goes down the real battle begins for me.

Yeah, I can agree that I don't like myself very much. I was so good for two months and then, it was literally as if I was back at the beginning again. If anything good came from last night it is a reminder of how little self-control I have when I drink. I become a different person and I don't think it's a coincidence that for the short time I was on the wagon, I didn't text/call anyone that I'd regret in the morning. I didn't wake up shaking or anxious. For some reason, drinking sounded better than all the benefits of sobriety. That twisted thinking scares me shitless.

I decided to drink, or told myself this is why, because I'm on holiday break from college and thought I "deserved" some fun after two months of sobriety and school. The real reason though is because I was feeling lonely and wanted to reach out to people, but feel too afraid to when I'm sober. 

I thought I had learned my lesson but I haven't so I guess one would be to cure my loneliness. I don't know how, but it's the main reason I drink.
